notes: First task of the split: GARDEN-009 and GARDEN-010 code against these signatures. docs/architecture/README.md gets DashRules in the Egg Garden row only. Pinned places that change: the 60% test in GardenRules.spec; the weather order check, the D1 string and the mutation string in GardenConfig.spec; schemaVersion in GardenProgress.spec. Choices the architecture leaves open, for A09 to fold into section 3.8: (1) Round.at in racing moves to min(limit, first finish + grace), because Round has no field for the first finish, so `at` is always the real end and step just compares it; (2) a sweeper's arms lie along (cos a, -sin a) in x, z, which is CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0) as DashFx uses it; (3) knock's 'away' is horizontal, with +x when the root is straight below the centre, so a hit never pushes a root into the deck; (4) setReady refuses a seventh ready; (5) a speed breach ends that sample, so a breach never counts a fall or a zone; (6) the speed check allows 1e-9 so the T10 31-stud value holds in floats, and fails on NaN; (7) a last runner striking out with no finisher ends with reason empty; (8) HatchRules.apply also refuses a fixed mutation from any other egg, and any other mutation from the Celestial Egg. Design note for the checkpoint: the 28 s minimum finish has less margin than T7 says. Zones are 16 radius, so an honest run is about 495 studs, 30.9 s at walk speed, about 29 s with a bounce; T7 says 33.75 s. Check at the greybox gate.
